definitions.explanation: Expenses connected with holding meetings or conferences — room rental, drinks and light refreshments, materials, and so on. A standard accounting category in Japanese corporate bookkeeping, distinct from entertainment expenses ({接待|せったい}{交際|こうさい}{費|ひ}).

examples.japanese: {会議費|かいぎひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To record meeting expenses on the books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会議費|かいぎひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This month's meeting expenses exceeded the budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧や⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会議費|かいぎひ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: The cost of tea and snacks served at meetings is booked as meeting expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧や⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{会議費|かいぎひ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧⟦{交際|こうさい}{費|ひ}→交際費：19159_kousaihi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Depending on the amount and content, food and drink with a business partner may be booked either as meeting expenses or as entertainment expenses.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (meeting, conference) and ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense, cost). A standard expense category on Japanese corporate income statements and tax filings, covering costs directly related to holding business meetings: conference-room rental, light refreshments for attendees, printed materials, and projector/whiteboard supplies.

CULTURAL / ACCOUNTING NOTE:
{会議費|かいぎひ} is carefully distinguished from ⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧⟦{交際|こうさい}{費|ひ}→交際費：19159_kousaihi⟧ (entertainment expenses) in Japanese tax practice. Light refreshments served during a genuine working meeting are {会議費|かいぎひ} and fully deductible, while lavish meals or drinking parties are classified as entertainment expenses and subject to stricter deduction limits. The distinction is a frequent point of discussion for accountants and managers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会議費|かいぎひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to book meeting expenses
- {会議費|かいぎひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process (a cost) as a meeting expense
- {会議費|かいぎひ}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: meeting expense budget
- {会議費|かいぎひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧: settlement/reimbursement of meeting expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧⟦{交際|こうさい}{費|ひ}→交際費：19159_kousaihi⟧: entertainment expenses — lavish hosting of clients, more restricted for tax purposes
- ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧: transportation expenses — travel-related costs
- ⟦{福利|ふくり}{厚生|こうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: welfare benefit expenses — employee welfare benefits
- {雑費|ざっぴ}: miscellaneous expenses — fallback category for small, uncategorized costs
